name: X13 Volume Rendering and Isosurface Plotting
definition: A Julia script (postprocessing/X13_3d_volume.jl) that generates 3D figures from simulation snapshots using GLMakie, producing volume renders and isosurfaces of scalar fields derived from velocity components.
summary: X13 generates immersive 3D volume renders and isosurface plots of turbulent flow structures via GPU raymarching, distinguishing itself from X12 by visualizing internal structures rather than using orthogonal cutting planes.
